input:
Our KVM/ARM64 host is experiencing a VM exit storm caused by vGIC maintenance interrupts. The guest is running a real-time workload with tight interrupt handling. The host CPU spending 60% of time in KVM exit handlers.

perf stat on host (1 second sample):
  142,301  kvm:kvm_exit  (reason: IRQ)
  141,987  kvm:kvm_entry
   89,201  kvm:kvm_exit  (reason: TRAP)
    3,102  kvm:kvm_exit  (reason: HVC)

ftrace kvm_exit breakdown:
  kvm_exit: reason=IRQ info=0x19 (maintenance IRQ)
    handle_exit: gic_handle_maintenance -> list_reg_sync
    duration: 2.8us
  (repeats 142K times/sec)

/proc/interrupts on host:
  29:  142301  142100  141899  142502  GICv3  25  Level  kvm-vgic-maintenance

Guest /proc/interrupts:
  IPI0:  45000  44800  45100  44900  Rescheduling interrupts
  IPI1:  12000  11800  12100  11900  Function call interrupts
  LOC:   90000  89800  90100  89900  Local timer interrupts

The guest timer frequency is 90KHz per CPU (4 CPUs = 360KHz total) but host maintenance IRQ count is 142KHz per CPU. Where are the extra maintenance interrupts coming from?
